name: toast
title: Toast
description: A short message that appears briefly and does not block the page.
a11y: Announced politely by assistive tech without moving focus.
Pauses its timer on hover and focus; F8 jumps focus to the toast region.
Never the only place a critical result appears; keep an inline message too.
A toast with an action (Undo) dismisses itself after `duration` (default about 5 s) and pauses while hovered or focused; give it a longer duration, or Infinity, when the action matters.
